question: Does the seed-first clustering test select a native base-12 BB-PBH scaffold behavior while rejecting uniform-cosmic and post-BB-only controls?
scope_note: CR026 is a profile-behavior candidate test. It supports PBH-first clustering but does not derive the native mass function, abundance normalization, or concentration law.
rule_9_falsification: This test could have falsified: the claim that BB-origin PBH/trapped-A seed-first clustering explains most of the baryon-to-clustered-halo gap while wrong controls fail.
